1.web: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
1.asv: God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.

2.web: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
2.asv: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? [Selah

3.web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
3.asv: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

4.web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
4.asv: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

5.web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
5.asv: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

6.web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
6.asv: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.

7.web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
7.asv: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.

8.web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
8.asv: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
